h1:
Where to Stay in Pathum Thani?
10 Real-Reviewed Hotels
Prices Compared on 3 Sites
heroSub: 10 hand-picked Pathum Thani stays across every price tier — a 4-star hotel wired into Future Park Rangsit mall, Thai-style riverside villas on the Chao Phraya, and budget rooms and aparthotels around Lamlukka and Thammasat. From ฿530–2,200/night.
introH2: 🏙️ Why does location matter so much in Pathum Thani?
introHtml: Pathum Thani isn't a tourist town like Chiang Mai or Phuket — it's a Bangkok-fringe province people stay in for real reasons: an event at Future Park Rangsit, dropping a kid off at Thammasat, an expo at IMPACT Muang Thong, a round of golf, or a quiet riverside escape close to the city · The catch is that the districts pull in different directions — Rangsit sits at the northern end on Phahonyothin Road, Lamlukka leans east, while the old town and Sam Khok hug the Chao Phraya River. Book in the wrong area and you'll cross the province every day · This guide rounds up 10 Pathum Thani stays across every tier — from a 4-star mall hotel down to budget rooms from ฿530 — each with a full review page, prices compared across 3 sites, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Pathum Thani has no metro running into every district (the Red Line terminates at Rangsit, on the province's southern edge), so most people drive or use Grab · The key areas in this guide: Rangsit-Future Park (Thanyaburi) — connected to Future Park & Zpell mall, near the Red Line Rangsit station · Lamlukka — residential, from Klong 2 to Bueng Kham Phroi, near Thai Wake Park · Khlong Luang-Thammasat Rangsit — around the university, handy for parents and visitors · City-Bang Kadi-Sam Khok — the Chao Phraya riverside, near Bang Kadi industrial estate and quiet riverbank stays.

entries.name: Novotel Bangkok Future Park Rangsit
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rangsit-Thanyaburi · linked to Future Park & Zpell
entries.addr: 114 Phahonyothin Rd, Prachathipat, Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: Novotel is the most-reviewed hotel in this guide — 582 reviews and the default first pick in the Rangsit area because you can walk straight through into Future Park & Zpell mall: eat, shop, never step outside · It's an Accor-group hotel built to international standards, with a saltwater pool, gym and on-site dining · Guest reviews praise the clean, modern rooms and the everything-on-your-doorstep location — a fit for business travellers, expo-goers and families alike.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a group or staying several nights? The Executive rooms cost only a little more for a bit more space, and booking with breakfast included beats hunting for food outside in the morning.
pros: Linked to Future Park & Zpell mall — eat and shop without leaving
Accor-group international standard, clean modern rooms
Saltwater pool, gym and on-site restaurants
Most-reviewed in this guide at 582 reviews
cons: Priciest in the group — overkill if you just need a bed for the night
Mall-connected and busy, not for those seeking a quiet retreat

entries.name: Tinidee Hotel Bangkok Golf Club
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Kadi · Tiwanon Rd · Mueang Pathum Thani
entries.addr: 99/3 Moo 2, Tiwanon Road, Bang Kadi, Mueang Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: Tinidee is a 4-star hotel set right beside Bangkok Golf Club on the Bang Kadi side — ideal if you're here to play a round or simply want a roomy stay with green fairway views, starting from around ฿1,100, noticeably cheaper than most 4-star hotels · It has a saltwater pool and an on-site spa · Guest reviews praise the spacious rooms and calm atmosphere, though some note the location is fairly isolated and you'll need to drive out to find food.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Premium Deluxe Balcony rooms have a balcony overlooking the golf course — worth it for a longer, relaxed stay. Because the surroundings are quiet with few restaurants, check whether the hotel runs a shuttle before you book.
pros: Beside the golf course — great for golfers
Roomy, cheaper than most 4-star hotels
Saltwater pool and on-site spa
Quiet, private atmosphere
cons: Fairly isolated spot with few nearby restaurants
No metro nearby — you'll want a car or Grab

entries.name: HOP INN Rangsit
entries.addr: 92 Phahonyothin Rd, Prachathipat, Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: HOP INN Rangsit is the most-reviewed budget option in this group — 467 reviews, scoring 8.7, well above what you pay · It's a HOP INN-group hotel built on simplicity and predictability: clean rooms, comfy beds, free parking, in the Rangsit area within walking distance of Future Park · There's no pool and no breakfast, but reviewers agree a clean room at this price is a strong deal for anyone who just needs a good bed in transit.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Every HOP INN charges the same rate all week — booking far ahead won't save much, but it also won't spike on weekends like other places. There are restaurants and convenience stores within walking distance, so breakfast is no problem.
pros: Scores 8.7, above its price point, with 467 reviews
Clean rooms and comfy beds — HOP INN-group standard
Free parking · walk to Future Park
Fixed pricing, no weekend surcharge
cons: No pool, no breakfast, no gym
Rooms are functional and plain, no decorative flourishes

entries.name: B2 Rangsit Boutique & Budget Hotel
entries.addr: 48/121 Moo 1, Phahonyothin Rd, Khlong Nueng, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: B2 Rangsit is the cheapest stay in this guide, from just ฿550, yet it scores 8.6 across 445 reviews · It's a B2-group budget hotel with fairly new rooms, right on Phahonyothin Road in the Khlong Luang-Rangsit area, with easy access on and off the main road · There's a Deluxe Triple for three people or a small family · Reviewers say a clean, newer room at this price is a real bargain — a good fit for tight budgets that just need a bed near Rangsit.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The ฿550 entry rooms have two single beds; for a big bed, the Superior Premier is only a hundred baht more. Since it sits on a main road, ask for an inner or rear-facing room for a quieter night.
pros: Cheapest stay in this guide at ฿550
Fairly new, clean rooms — B2 group
Right on Phahonyothin Road, easy access
Triple rooms for three / small families
cons: On a main road — front rooms may catch traffic noise
It's a budget hotel: no pool, no breakfast

entries.name: Ingnatee Resort
entries.addr: 62 Moo 7, Chiang Rak Yai, Sam Khok, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: Ingnatee has an atmosphere unlike anything else on this list — a boutique resort of 11 Thai-style villas on the Chao Phraya River in Sam Khok · The draw is private villas set in a tropical garden, with a river-view pool, a mushroom farm and bicycles to ride, ideal for couples or families wanting to escape the bustle for a riverside stay close to Bangkok · It has few reviews (33) because it's a small resort, but the ones it has praise the calm and the privacy of each villa.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're here specifically for the river view, book a Riverview Villa — the standard Deluxe Villas face the garden. As a small resort, the riverside villas fill up fast, so book ahead, especially on weekends.
pros: Private Thai-style villas on the Chao Phraya River
Quiet, relaxing escape close to Bangkok
River-view pool, tropical garden and bicycles
Great for couples and families wanting privacy
cons: Few reviews so far (33) as it's a small resort
Sam Khok is fairly remote — you'll need a car · river-view villas cost more

entries.name: Sena House Lamlukka Klong2
entries.addr: 39/9 Lamlukka 11 Alley, Khu Khot, Lamlukka, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: Sena House holds the highest review score in this guide at 8.9, even though the review count is still small (33) because it's a small, newly opened stay · It's a budget studio guesthouse in the Lamlukka-Klong 2 (Khu Khot) area, with queen-bed studios — some with a city-view balcony — from just ฿530 · Reviewers praise the clean, new rooms and an attentive owner, making it a fit for visitors with business around Lamlukka-Khu Khot or anyone after a cheap bed near the Green Line at Khu Khot.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For about 80 baht more you get the Studio with Balcony — worth it if you'd like a sitting space. Parking is limited, so if you're driving, ask ahead.
pros: Highest score in the guide at 8.9, clean new rooms
From just ฿530 with a queen bed
Some rooms have a balcony · attentive owner
Near the Green Line at Khu Khot
cons: Few reviews (33) as a small, newly opened stay
Limited parking, no pool, no breakfast

entries.name: The Seasons
entries.addr: 39/9 Moo 18, Bueng Kham Phroi, Lamlukka, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: The Seasons is an aparthotel where rooms come with a kitchenette, fridge and balcony in the Bueng Kham Phroi area of Lamlukka, scoring 8.2 across 42 reviews · What sets it apart from a regular hotel is being able to cook simple meals in your room, which suits multi-night or longer stays around Lamlukka · Reviewers say the rooms are spacious in an apartment sense and good value for a long stay, though the location is fairly deep in and you'll want a car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Staying several nights and want to save on food? Pick a room with a kitchenette and buy groceries to cook in. The location sits deep within the Lamlukka area, so plan for a car or Grab.
pros: Apartment-style rooms with kitchenette and fridge
Spacious rooms with a balcony, good for long stays
Good value for multi-night stays
Lamlukka area, quieter than Rangsit
cons: Tucked deep in — you'll need a car or Grab
Few reviews so far (42) · no pool

entries.name: Pathum Thani Place Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Kadi · Tiwanon Rd · city centre
entries.addr: 123 Moo 1, Tiwanon Road, Bang Kadi, Mueang Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: Pathum Thani Place is a hotel in the city centre on Tiwanon Road, Bang Kadi, scoring 7.7 across 168 reviews · It suits anyone with business in town, dealing with government offices, or working around the Bang Kadi industrial estate · The plus points are spacious rooms and a central location with food and sights within reach · Reviewers say you get a big room at a modest price, though parts of the hotel are starting to show their age — the building isn't new.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Standard rooms are already roomy, but if you want one that looks newer with a work space, step up to the Superior. Being in town, you'll find restaurants and convenience stores all around.
pros: Central Pathum Thani location, easy to find food nearby
Spacious rooms at a modest price
Good for official business / Bang Kadi estate work
Has parking
cons: Building and some rooms are showing their age
Middling score — more functional than atmospheric

entries.name: Dluxx Thammasat
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Luang · next to Thammasat Rangsit
entries.addr: 99 Moo 18, Phirap Khao Rd, Khlong Nueng, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: Dluxx Thammasat is a stay right next to Thammasat University, Rangsit campus, scoring 7.6 across 207 reviews · It suits parents dropping off a student, university visitors, or anyone here for an event at Thammasat · Rooms are apartment-style with a balcony, and there's a Family Room for groups · Reviewers praise being able to walk into the campus, though some note the upkeep and freshness of the rooms can be inconsistent.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: During graduation and the start of term, rooms near Thammasat Rangsit fill fast and rates rise, so book several weeks ahead. Travelling as a group? The Family Room beats booking several rooms.
pros: Next to Thammasat Rangsit — walk into campus
Apartment-style rooms with a balcony
Family rooms for groups
Good for parents and university visitors
cons: Room upkeep and freshness can be inconsistent
Fills fast and prices rise around graduation / term start

entries.name: Thana Residence Lamlukka
entries.addr: 83 Thetsaban Lam Luk Ka 3 Rd, Lam Luk Ka, Lam Luk Ka District, Pathum Thani
entries.storyHtml: Thana Residence is a small, quiet apartment-style residence in the Lamlukka area, near Thai Wake Park, scoring 7.7 across 90 reviews · Rooms run about 24 sqm with a balcony and fridge, plus free parking — a fit for anyone wanting a quiet spot for a longer stay or a visit to ride wakeboards · Reviewers say the rooms are spacious and peaceful, though it's a small property without hotel-style facilities, and the location is tucked deep in, so you'll want a car.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a longer stay or a separate bedroom, the One-Bedroom Apartment is only 200 baht more. The property sits deep within Lamlukka, so having your own car is the easiest option.
pros: Spacious ~24 sqm rooms with balcony and fridge
Quiet and private, good for longer stays
Free parking · near Thai Wake Park
Good value for an apartment-style room
cons: Small property: no pool, no breakfast
Tucked deep in — you'll want your own car

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Pathum Thani stay for your trip

advice.head: Here for an event or shopping at Future Park Rangsit
advice.bodyHtml: → Novotel Future Park Rangsit ฿1,900, walk straight into the mall · or on a budget, HOP INN Rangsit ฿650, also within walking distance

advice.head: Visiting Thammasat Rangsit — drop-off or business
advice.bodyHtml: → Dluxx Thammasat ฿850, next to the campus and walkable · with a Family Room for the whole family

advice.head: Tightest budget, just need a good bed
advice.bodyHtml: → Sena House Lamlukka ฿530, the guide's top score of 8.9 · or B2 Rangsit ฿550, newer rooms on the main road

advice.head: Want a quiet riverside escape near Bangkok
advice.bodyHtml: → Ingnatee Resort ฿2,200, Thai-style villas on the Chao Phraya River in Sam Khok, great for couples and families

advice.head: Here to golf, or want a roomy 4-star
advice.bodyHtml: → Tinidee Hotel Bangkok Golf Club ฿1,100, beside the golf course with a saltwater pool and spa

advice.head: Long stay, want a kitchen or extra space
advice.bodyHtml: → The Seasons ฿790, rooms with a kitchenette · or Thana Residence ฿850, spacious ~24 sqm rooms, quiet in the Lamlukka area

advice.head: Business in central Pathum Thani / Bang Kadi estate
advice.bodyHtml: → Pathum Thani Place Hotel ฿800, in town on Tiwanon Road, Bang Kadi, with food all around

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and can change by date and season — always check the live price and compare 3 sites before booking · Pathum Thani's metro doesn't reach every area (the Red Line ends at Rangsit, the Green Line at Khu Khot), so most travel is by car or Grab · Scores and review counts are drawn from real guest reviews on online booking platforms · Article by ThailandAddict.
faqTitle: FAQ — Common questions about staying in Pathum Thani

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay in Pathum Thani?
faq.a: It depends on why you're here · Rangsit-Future Park (Thanyaburi) is best for mall events or work, with the easiest transport (Novotel, HOP INN, B2) · Khlong Luang suits Thammasat Rangsit visitors (Dluxx Thammasat) · Lamlukka is good for a quiet or longer stay (The Seasons, Thana Residence, Sena House) · City-Sam Khok on the Chao Phraya riverside suits government business or a riverside retreat (Pathum Thani Place, Tinidee, Ingnatee)

faq.q: ❓ How much do hotels in Pathum Thani cost?
faq.a: Quite a range: budget hotels and guesthouses start around ฿530–850 per night (Sena House, B2, HOP INN) · aparthotels and 3-star hotels run about ฿790–1,100 · 4-star hotels start at ฿1,100–1,900 (Tinidee, Novotel) · riverside villa resorts from around ฿2,200 (Ingnatee) · Prices can rise during big expos at IMPACT Muang Thong or Thammasat graduation season

faq.q: ❓ Does the metro reach Pathum Thani?
faq.a: Not every area · The Red Line terminates at Rangsit station (the province's southern edge, near Novotel/HOP INN) and the Green Line extends to Khu Khot (near Sena House in Lamlukka-Klong 2) · The city centre, Sam Khok and inner Lamlukka still rely mainly on car or Grab

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay for Thammasat Rangsit?
faq.a: Dluxx Thammasat is right next to the campus and walkable, ideal for parents dropping off a student or anyone visiting, with a Family Room for groups · During graduation and the start of term, rooms near campus fill very fast, so book several weeks ahead

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Pathum Thani hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary by current promotions, so it's worth comparing all 3 before every booking — each review page in this guide has price-comparison links, which can save tens to hundreds of baht per night

faq.q: ❓ Is there a quiet stay near Bangkok in Pathum Thani?
faq.a: Yes · Ingnatee Resort in Sam Khok is a boutique resort of Thai-style villas on the Chao Phraya River, with a garden and river-view pool, ideal for escaping the bustle close to Bangkok · For something cheaper and still peaceful, Thana Residence in Lamlukka is a small, quiet, private residence
